participants.role_in_journey: Fraud victim who reports the APP fraud and receives the reimbursement decision and credit.

interactions.trigger: Customer realises they have been defrauded or receives a real-time payment block notification
interactions.action: Navigates to 'Report Fraud' in mobile app (CH-002) or calls the fraud reporting line (CH-004)
interactions.system_response: SVC-013 creates FraudCase with trigger_type = customer_report or realtime_block. FraudCaseCreated event published. Customer receives case reference number via push notification (SVC-053).
data_provided_by_customer: Transaction reference of suspect payment (selectable from transaction history in app)
Brief description of the social engineering method (e.g. impersonation scam, investment fraud, romance fraud)
data_received_by_customer: Confirmation that the case has been received
Expected decision timeline: within 5 business days

interactions.trigger: Fraud Analyst may request additional information from the customer during case creation
interactions.action: Customer receives a secure message in mobile app or email requesting any additional evidence (e.g. screenshots of communications from the fraudster, payee details given to them)
interactions.channel: CH-002 (Secure in-app message) or email via SVC-053
interactions.system_response: SVC-053 dispatches secure evidence request message. Customer uploads evidence via mobile app secure upload. Evidence stored as FraudEvidence record (evidence_type = communication_log).
data_provided_by_customer: Screenshots of fraudulent communications (WhatsApp, email, text)
Payee name and details as provided by the fraudster

interactions.trigger: Analyst may require a call with the customer to clarify specific details
interactions.action: Customer receives a call from the fraud team (outbound call from verified bank number) or a secure in-app message
interactions.system_response: Agent records contact attempt and outcome in FraudEvidence (evidence_type = communication_log).
data_provided_by_customer: Detailed account of the social engineering method
Confirmation of any warnings seen before the payment
Vulnerability information if relevant (e.g. recently bereaved, under duress)

interactions.action: If customer discloses vulnerability (financial difficulty, bereavement, mental health, age), this is flagged in FraudCase.vulnerability_assessment and escalated per Consumer Duty requirements
interactions.system_response: Vulnerability indicator added to FraudCase.vulnerability_assessment. Gross negligence threshold elevated. Additional support resources offered via SVC-053.

interactions.trigger: Reimbursement decision reached (approve, partial, or decline)
interactions.action: Customer receives regulated outcome letter via email and in-app notification
interactions.channel: CH-002 (Push notification + in-app message) and email (SVC-053)
interactions.system_response: SVC-053 dispatches outcome letter. Content varies by decision outcome.
data_received_by_customer_approve: Expected credit date (within 5 business days of original report)
How to contact the fraud team if the credit is not received
data_received_by_customer_partial: Amount to be credited and explanation of contributory negligence finding
FOS signpost: right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service within 6 months
data_received_by_customer_decline: Clear written explanation of the gross negligence finding (non-technical language)
FOS signpost: explicit statement of right to complain to FOS within 6 months
Contact details for the bank's internal complaints process
PSR's Consumer Guide to APP fraud reimbursement (link)
interactions.regulatory_requirement: Consumer Duty: outcome letter must be written in plain English, must not deter customer from pursuing a legitimate FOS complaint, and must include the FOS signpost on any decline.

interactions.trigger: Reimbursement credit applied to customer account
interactions.action: Customer receives push notification confirming the credit has been applied
interactions.system_response: SVC-053 dispatches credit confirmation notification triggered by ReimbursementCredited event. Credit is visible in account transaction history with description 'APP Fraud Reimbursement — Case [case_id]'.
SVC-053 dispatches closure notification. Case reference visible in mobile app case history for 90 days. Customer can access a case summary document.
data_received_by_customer: Confirmation that the case has been closed
Recovery information if applicable (receiving bank recovery — customer is informed but this does not affect their reimbursement)

access_controls.note: PER-001 sees only their case status, outcome decision, and financial outcome. Internal investigation data (fraud_score, model outputs, detailed evidence notes) is access-controlled to PER-054 and above.

participants.role_in_journey: Primary investigator. Owns the FraudCase from creation to closure. Responsible for evidence gathering, investigation, reimbursement decision recommendation, and case closure.
system_access: SVC-017 Read access (device data, session logs)
SVC-014 Read access (KYC/AML assessment — for vulnerability indicators)

interactions.action: Analyst opens assigned FraudCase from queue in SVC-013 case management UI
data_accessed: PaymentIntent: amount, payee_sort_code, payee_account_number, cop_result, cop_override_confirmed, fraud_score, fraud_risk_level
Customer: name, date_of_birth, KYC risk category
creates: FraudEvidence records for each evidence item gathered

interactions.action: Full investigation against PSR eligibility framework
decisions_made: Gross negligence assessment with evidence references
SAR referral decision (refer to MLRO or no further action)
Mule account check at this bank

interactions.action: Record formal reimbursement decision via POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision
escalation_rules: reimbursement_amount > £25,000: mandatory escalation to PER-059 (Senior Manager)
decision = decline: mandatory co-sign by PER-059 (Senior Manager)

interactions.action: Close FraudCase and publish fraud pattern feedback
outputs: FraudPatternDetected event published with anonymised pattern features

access_controls.note: PER-054 does not have access to SAR content — MLRO boundary applies (POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off). If a SAR exists for this customer, PER-054 is informed only that the case has been referred to the MLRO; no SAR content is visible.

participants.role_in_journey: Receives SAR referrals from the fraud investigation where organised fraud, mule networks, or internal collusion indicators are identified. Responsible for SAR decision (file or no further action) under POCA 2002 s330.

interactions.trigger: Fraud Analyst makes a SAR referral from PH-066 investigation
interactions.action: MLRO receives notification in SVC-015 case management UI. Reviews FraudCase evidence (anonymised — no tipping-off risk). Makes SAR filing decision per POCA 2002 s330 standard.
interactions.parallel_journey: If SAR filed: JRN-003 (SAR Filing) is triggered as a parallel journey. JRN-005 fraud investigation continues independently.
interactions.note: Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) strictly enforced. PER-054 is NOT informed of the SAR filing decision. Communication from PER-052 to fraud team is via the restricted channel only and excludes NCA reference.

interactions.trigger: EX-004: Receiving account is held at this bank
interactions.action: MLRO notified immediately via SVC-015. MLRO authorises account freeze. Initiates SAR assessment for the mule account holder.
interactions.urgency: Immediate — account freeze must occur before funds are withdrawn or transferred.

interactions.trigger: EX-003: Customer has submitted a previous APP fraud claim within 12 months
interactions.action: MLRO notified to review the repeat victim pattern. MLRO assesses whether enhanced vulnerability protections are required or whether repeat fraud-by-customer indicators are present.
interactions.outcome_fed_to_analyst: MLRO provides a recommendation to PER-054 (enhanced vulnerability confirmed or fraud-by-customer indicators) without disclosing any SAR content.

participants.role_in_journey: Mandatory escalation point for high-value cases (reimbursement > £25,000) and all gross negligence decline decisions. Also authorises stop-the-clock decisions (EX-005) and Pay.UK dispute escalations (EX-002).

interactions.trigger: Case escalated due to: reimbursement_amount > £25,000 OR decision = decline
interactions.action: Senior Manager reviews investigation findings, evidence quality, and decision rationale. Approves or overrides the analyst's recommendation. Records co-sign approval in SVC-013.
interactions.sla: Senior Manager review must complete within the PH-067 phase window to maintain the 5-day PSR SLA

interactions.trigger: Fraud Analyst identifies fraud-by-customer indicators and recommends stopping the clock
interactions.action: Senior Manager reviews the evidence and authorises or rejects the stop-the-clock decision. If authorised: customer is notified that additional time is needed. PSR clock paused.
interactions.regulatory_note: PSR PS23/3 stop-the-clock provisions are limited — must be used judiciously and evidence must be documented

interactions.trigger: Receiving PSP disputes the 50/50 recovery claim
interactions.action: Senior Manager reviews the dispute basis and authorises submission to Pay.UK dispute resolution mechanism. Approves the dispute submission via SVC-009 ReimbursementClaim management.

notification_matrix.description: Summary of all customer-facing notifications dispatched by SVC-053 (Notification Service) during JRN-005

notifications.content_summary: Fraud report received. Case reference [case_id]. Decision within 5 business days. Fraud team contact number.
Your fraud case is under investigation. Case reference [case_id]. You may be contacted for additional information.
Reimbursement approved. Amount [£X]. Credit will appear within [N] business days. If credit not received, call [number].
Reimbursement declined. Reason: [plain language explanation]. Right to complain to FOS within 6 months. FOS contact details enclosed.
£[X] has been credited to your account as APP Fraud Reimbursement — Case [case_id]. New balance: £[Y].
Your fraud case [case_id] has been closed. Summary available in the app for 90 days.
